note: ORPHAN Pro 24:26 — whoever gives an honest answer kisses the lips.

dims.v: forthright truthfulness — a straight, honest answer, welcome as a kiss

the giving of an honest, straightforward answer — the forthright truthfulness that speaks what is right and true, so welcome and pleasing that it is like a kiss on the lips, candour that honours the one it answers
the straight, truthful reply that is received as a mark of respect and love

nakoach (right/honest/straightforward) — 'whoever gives an HONEST answer kisses the lips' (24:26); a straight, truthful answer is a gift, as welcome and intimate as a kiss. Honest candour honours and pleases where evasion or flattery would wound (cf 27:5-6).
